1: // Neon Void Escape – minimal canvas game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the host HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
10: 
11:   // Ship state
12:   const ship = {
13:     x: width / 2,
14:     y: height * 0.8,
15:     angle: -Math.PI / 2,
16:     radius: 8,
17:     vx: 0,
18:     vy: 0,
19:     thrust: 0.05,
20:     rotateSpeed: 0.07,
21:   };
22: 
23:   // Obstacles array
24:   const obstacles = [];
25:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
26:   const obstacleInterval = 90; // frames
27:   let score = 0;
28:   let gameOver = false;
29: 
30:   // Input handling
31:   const keys = {};
32:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
33:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
34: 
35:   function spawnObstacle() {
36:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 15;
37:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size) + size / 2;
38:     const speed = Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5;
39:     obstacles.push({ x, y: -size, size, speed });
40:   }
41: 
42:   function update() {
43:     if (gameOver) return;
44:     // Controls
45:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.angle -= ship.rotateSpeed;
46:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.angle += ship.rotateSpeed;
47:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) {
48:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
49:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
50:     }
51:     // Apply velocity & wrap
52:     ship.x += ship.vx;
53:     ship.y += ship.vy;
54:     // simple friction
55:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
56:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
57:     // Keep ship within canvas (wrap horizontally, bounce vertically)
58:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += width;
59:     if (ship.x > width) ship.x -= width;
60:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = 0, ship.vy = 0;
61:     if (ship.y > height) ship.y = height, ship.vy = 0;
62: 
63:     // Obstacles
64:     obstacleTimer++;
65:     if (obstacleTimer >= obstacleInterval) {
66:       obstacleTimer = 0;
67:       spawnObstacle();
68:     }
69:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
70:       const o = obstacles[i];
71:       o.y += o.speed;
72:       // Remove off‑screen
73:       if (o.y - o.size > height) {
74:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
75:         score++;
76:         continue;
77:       }
78:       // Collision detection (circle‑rect approximation)
79:       const dx = Math.abs(ship.x - o.x);
80:       const dy = Math.abs(ship.y - o.y);
81:       if (dx < o.size / 2 + ship.radius && dy < o.size / 2 + ship.radius) {
82:         gameOver = true;
83:       }
84:     }
85:   }
86: 
87:   function draw() {
88:     // Clear with dark background
89:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a0a';
90:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
91: 
92:     // Draw ship (neon triangle)
93:     ctx.save();
94:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
95:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
96:     ctx.beginPath();
97:     ctx.moveTo(10, 0);
98:     ctx.lineTo(-8, -6);
99:     ctx.lineTo(-8, 6);
100:     ctx.closePath();
101:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffff';
102:     ctx.fill();
103:     ctx.restore();
104: 
105:     // Draw obstacles (neon squares)
106:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff00ff';
107:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
108:       ctx.fillRect(o.x - o.size / 2, o.y - o.size / 2, o.size, o.size);
109:     });
110: 
111:     // Score
112:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
113:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
114:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
115: 
116:     if (gameOver) {
117:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
118:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
119:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5555';
120:       ctx.font = '32px monospace';
121:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
122:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
123:     }
124:   }
125: 
126:   function loop() {
127:     update();
128:     draw();
129:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
130:   }
131: 
132:   // Start the loop
133:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
134: })();
